description: QIFNEB crystallizes in the monoclinic crystal system with space group P 21/n. Reported CIF formula moiety: C66 H102 I2 N4 O4 Yb2. From the CIF bond table, Yb1 (Yb) has 2 O neighbors; Yb2 (Yb) has 2 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal connectivity is not established from the available bond table. Article card reports molecular formula [YbI(DippForm)(thf)2]2.
